extracted.intended_audience: Brown University investigators, faculty, scholars, and research staff seeking institutional support for research and funding
extracted.subtask_description: Information about the Division of Research’s services and expectations for supporting researchers across the research lifecycle, including identifying funding, proposal submission, contract negotiation, compliance, technology transfer, and community engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support investigators at every stage
rubrics_metrics.description: The Division of Research 'supports its investigators and scholars at every stage of their research cycle.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an overarching standard: Brown provides continuous institutional assistance from project conception through outcomes to position faculty for research success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop initial research strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Partner with researchers to 'develop initial research strategies.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutional expectation: projects should begin with a deliberate strategy developed with Division partners to increase competitiveness and clarity of aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance implies proactive help matching projects to appropriate external sponsors and calls for proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal preparation and submission
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes pre-award support such as application preparation, review, and submission processes to reduce researcher burden and improve proposal quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negotiate contracts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutional negotiation support to secure favorable terms and ensure compliance with university policies and sponsor requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish funding structures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post-award administrative setup and account structures are managed to ensure proper financial administration of awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guide technology transfer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support for translating research outputs into protected and licensed technologies, including IP evaluation and commercialization pathways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support startup ventures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assistance for researchers aiming to form startups based on university research, including commercialization and entrepreneurial resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce administrative workload for researchers
rubrics_metrics.description: Aim to 'make the research process less complex' and 'reduce the administrative workload for Brown researchers.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational objective: centralize and streamline administrative tasks so investigators can focus on research; implies services and systems designed to minimize administrative overhead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect intellectual property
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectation that the Division will provide IP protection services and guidance (e.g., disclosures, patenting, licensing) to safeguard inventions and creative works.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative processes and policies are in place to identify and mitigate financial or other conflicts that could affect research integrity or compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure integrity of research
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and oversight functions to uphold ethical conduct, research ethics, responsible data practices, and trustworthy scholarship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain compliance with state and federal regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain 'compliance with state and federal regulations.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Division provides compliance infrastructure (e.g., human subjects, animal care, export controls, financial reporting) to satisfy legal and sponsor requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase external funding of research
rubrics_metrics.description: Aim to 'increase external funding of research at Brown.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A performance objective: institutional support and strategic positioning to help faculty secure more competitive external awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage the research community
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain calendars, events, and communications to 'engage with Brown’s research community.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides networking, conferences, talks, and announcements (e.g., AI+X Networking Series) to foster collaboration, visibility, and cross-disciplinary work.
